title: Kelowna Art Gallery

services.name: School Tour Program
services.desc: Our school tours are inquiry based. Students look closely, talk about what they see, and make work in response. Each tour pairs an exhibition with a hands-on art activity, and is offered to students of all ages. Tours are $6 per student, run 1 hour 30 minutes, and accommodate up to 30 students. Each tour below opens with a question and lists what it offers different grade levels. To make a booking request, please click BOOK NOW on the relevant tour page below to access the booking form.
